name: late-night-cropped-hoodie-selfie
image_purpose: Night lifestyle post and casual apartment moodboard

prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic late-night smartphone selfie in a quiet apartment living room.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult Mediterranean brunette with black-brown hair in a high ponytail, hazel eyes, and natural skin texture. She wears a black cropped hoodie over secure black high-waisted lounge shorts, holds a smartphone with one hand, and lightly grips the hoodie hem with the other while showing a small playful smile.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 phone-selfie framing with the subject from head to upper thighs, a couch, warm table lamp, dark window, and quiet apartment background. Keep the relaxed night-selfie perspective and natural mirror/phone geometry.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm bedside or table-lamp glow with soft shadows on the hoodie and room, slight digital noise, calm late-night apartment atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: iPhone 15 Pro Max look, 24mm, 9:16, realistic smartphone sharpness, subtle grain, natural skin pores and cotton texture, no artificial smoothing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: An ultra-photorealistic 9:16 late-night smartphone selfie of one approved adult Mediterranean brunette with black-brown hair in a high ponytail, hazel eyes, and natural skin texture. She wears a black cropped hoodie over secure black high-waisted lounge shorts, holds a smartphone with one hand, and lightly grips the hoodie hem with the other while showing a small playful smile. Include a couch, warm table lamp, dark window, quiet apartment, soft lamp glow, natural shadows, slight digital noise, realistic cotton and skin texture, and casual authentic night-selfie energy.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, thong, braless exposure, sexualized pose, explicit body-part emphasis, child or teen appearance, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, harsh flash, distorted hands, extra fingers, deformed, random text, watermark, low resolution, blur
